name: QualtricsXM
description: Integrates Qualtrics Experience Management surveys: connects to the Qualtrics API with a token to list/fetch surveys, exposes a survey page that iframe-embeds a survey, and includes submodules for a survey field/formatter (embed) and insight tracking.
project_description:
Embed Qualtrics Surveys into your Drupal Pages 
 Provide easy access to your Qualtrics surveys on your Drupal or govCMS site.

 This module allows you to add a new Content Field Type or a block so Drupal users can create pages that embed surveys and forms that resize automatically as site visitors provide their responses. Simply have content authors pull down and select their desired Qualtrics survey from a pulldown list connected to their Qualtrics account. Collecting responses via Qualtrics makes it a lot easier to analyse than using native Drupal forms functionality. 

 You will need to create a Qualtrics account and API token to make use of this module. We're keen to hear from you so please reach out if you have thoughts and ideas.
